# TextBlockExtensions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Fluent extension methods for text blocks

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`AlignCenter`](#aligncenter): Sets the text alignment to center
- [`AlignJustify`](#alignjustify): Sets the text alignment to justified
- [`AlignLeft`](#alignleft): Sets the text alignment to left
- [`AlignRight`](#alignright): Sets the text alignment to right
- [`Bold`](#bold): Sets the font weight to Bold (700).
- [`Color`](#color): Sets the text color for the text block
- [`Font`](#font): Sets the font family for the text block.
- [`FontSize`](#fontsize): Sets the font size for the text block
- [`FontWeight`](#fontweight): Sets the font weight for the text block (e.g. FontWeight.Bold, FontWeight.Light).
- [`Italic`](#italic): Enables italic/oblique rendering.
- [`Light`](#light): Sets the font weight to Light (300).
- [`Strikethrough`](#strikethrough): Adds strikethrough decoration to the text block
- [`Underline`](#underline): Adds underline decoration to the text block

### `Bold`

```csharp
TextBlock Bold(TextBlock b)
```

*static*

Sets the font weight to Bold (700). Requires FontFamily to be set via `Font` for automatic resolution.

### `Color`

```csharp
TextBlock Color(TextBlock b, Color color)
```

*static*

Sets the text color for the text block

### `Font`

```csharp
TextBlock Font(TextBlock b, string fontName, float? fontSize = null)
```

*static*

Sets the font family for the text block. When used with `FontWeight` or `Italic`, the correct font variant is resolved automatically (e.g. "Helvetica" + Bold → "Helvetica-Bold").

### `FontSize`

```csharp
TextBlock FontSize(TextBlock b, float size)
```

*static*

Sets the font size for the text block

### `FontWeight`

```csharp
TextBlock FontWeight(TextBlock b, FontWeight weight)
```

*static*

Sets the font weight for the text block (e.g. FontWeight.Bold, FontWeight.Light). Requires FontFamily to be set via `Font` for automatic resolution.

### `Italic`

```csharp
TextBlock Italic(TextBlock b)
```

*static*

Enables italic/oblique rendering. Requires FontFamily to be set via `Font` for automatic resolution.

### `Light`

```csharp

```

*static*

Sets the font weight to Light (300). Requires FontFamily to be set via `Font` for automatic resolution.
